/**
 * @file
 * @brief Zephyr testing framework
 *
 * This is the header for the Zephyr testing framework. This is a private header
 * and should not be included by applications.
 */

#ifndef ZEPHYR_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_TEST_H_
#define ZEPHYR_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_TEST_H_

#include <zephyr/kernel.h>
#include <zephyr/sys/iterable_sections.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

struct ztest_unit_test;

/**
 * @brief Test suite struct
 *
 * @param name Name of the test suite.
 * @param unit_tests An array of `ztest_unit_test`.
 * @param stats A pointer to a `ztest_suite_stats` struct.
 * @param pre_fn A function to be run before any of the tests in the suite are
 * run.
 * @param post_fn A function to be run after all of the tests in the suite have
 * been run.
 */
struct ztest_suite_node {
	const char *name;
	const struct ztest_unit_test *const *unit_tests;
	struct ztest_suite_stats *stats;
	ztest_handler pre_fn;
	ztest_handler post_fn;
};

/**
 * @brief A test case
 *
 * @param name Name of the test case.
 * @param test The test function.
 * @param setup The setup function.
 * @param teardown The teardown function.
 */
struct ztest_unit_test {
	const char *name;
	ztest_handler test;
	ztest_handler setup;
	ztest_handler teardown;
};

/**
 * @brief Test suite statistics
 *
 * @param fail_count The number of failed tests.
 * @param run_count The number of run tests.
 */
struct ztest_suite_stats {
	int fail_count;
	int run_count;
};

/**
 * @brief Run a test suite
 *
 * @param suite The test suite to run.
 */
void z_ztest_run_test_suite(const char *name, struct ztest_suite_node *suite);

/**
 * @brief Get the number of test suites
 *
 * @return The number of test suites.
 */
int z_ztest_get_num_test_suites(void);

/**
 * @brief A single test case, with a setup and teardown function.
 *
 * This is for the new API.
 *
 * @param fn The test function.
 * @param setup The setup function.
 * @param teardown The teardown function.
 */
#define ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(fn, setup, teardown)
	static void fn(void);
	static const struct ztest_unit_test __ztest_unit_test_##fn = {
		.name = #fn,
		.test = fn,
		.setup = setup,
		.teardown = teardown,
	};
	static void fn(void)

/**
 * @brief A single test case.
 *
 * This is for the new API.
 *
 * @param fn The test function.
 */
#define ZTEST_UNIT_TEST(fn)
	ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(fn, NULL, NULL)

/**
 * @brief A single test case, with a setup and teardown function.
 *
 * This is for the new API.
 *
 * @param fn The test function.
 * @param setup The setup function.
 * @param teardown The teardown function.
 */
#define ztest_unit_test_setup_teardown(fn, setup, teardown)
	ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(fn, setup, teardown)

/**
 * @brief Register a test suite, with pre and post functions.
 *
 * This is for the new API.
 *
 * @param suite_name The name of the test suite.
 * @param suite An array of test cases.
 * @param stats A pointer to a `ztest_suite_stats` struct.
 * @param pre The pre function.
 * @param post The post function.
 */
#define ZTEST_SUITE_REGISTRATION_PRE_POST(suite_name, suite, stats, pre, post)
	static const struct ztest_suite_node _CONCAT(__ztest_suite_node_, suite_name) = {
		.name = #suite_name,
		.unit_tests = suite,
		.stats = stats,
		.pre_fn = pre,
		.post_fn = post,
	};
	STRUCT_SECTION_ITERABLE(ztest_suite_node,
		_CONCAT(__ztest_suite_node_, suite_name))

/**
 * @brief Register a test suite.
 *
 * This is for the new API.
 *
 * @param suite_name The name of the test suite.
 * @param suite An array of test cases.
 * @param stats A pointer to a `ztest_suite_stats` struct.
 */
#define ZTEST_SUITE_REGISTRATION(suite_name, suite, stats)
	ZTEST_SUITE_REGISTRATION_PRE_POST(suite_name, suite, stats, NULL, NULL)

/**
 * @brief A test suite, with pre and post functions.
 *
 * This is for the new API.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param pre_fn The pre function.
 * @param post_fn The post function.
 * @param ... A list of test cases.
 */
#define ztest_test_suite_pre_post(suite, pre_fn, post_fn, ...)
	static const struct ztest_unit_test *const __ztest_suite_##suite[] = {
		__VA_ARGS__, NULL
	};
	struct ztest_suite_stats __ztest_suite_stats_##suite;
	ZTEST_SUITE_REGISTRATION_PRE_POST(suite, __ztest_suite_##suite,
		&__ztest_suite_stats_##suite, pre_fn, post_fn)

/**
 * @brief A test suite.
 *
 * This is for the new API.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param ... A list of test cases.
 */
#define ztest_test_suite(suite, ...)\
	ztest_test_suite_pre_post(suite, NULL, NULL, __VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief A simple test suite.
 *
 * This is for the new API.
 *
 * @param ... A list of test cases.
 */
#define ztest_simple_test_suite(...)
	ztest_test_suite(simple, __VA_ARGS__)

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* ZEPHYR_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_TEST_H_ */
